item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00326","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C01","C21","C06"],"selected_candidate_label":"C01","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C01 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Its commission-establishment language and, most decisively, its financing provision are reproduced in the child with the same appropriation, act, date, and three-part waiver formula. The child substantially compresses and adapts C01's machinery by changing the body's subject, advisory function, and compensation rule. C21 and C06 contain closely related financing machinery, but C01 is the strongest because its operative text matches the child almost verbatim and concerns a presidential commission established immediately before the child.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby established the President's Advisory Committee on Government Organization.","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established in the Executive Office of the President a commission to be known as the President's Commission on Immigration and Naturalization","explanation":"Both begin by establishing a presidential advisory body using the same operative construction."},{"child_excerpt":"The members of the Committee shall be appointed by the President and shall serve as such members without compensation.","parent_excerpt":"a Chairman, a Vice Chairman, and five other members, all of whom shall be designated by the President... The members of the Commission shall receive such compensation and expense allowances... as the President shall hereafter fix","explanation":"The child retains presidential selection of members while adapting the parent body's compensation arrangement."},{"child_excerpt":"The expenditures of the Committee shall be paid out of an allotment to be made by the President from the appropriation entitled \"Emergency Fund for the President—National Defense\" in Title I of the Independent Offices Appropriation Act, 1953 (Public Law 455, 82nd Congress), approved July 5, 1952.","parent_excerpt":"The expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation entitled \"Emergency Fund for the President-National Defense\" in Title I of the Independent Offices Appropriation Act, 1953 (Public Law 455, 82nd Congress), approved July 5, 1952.","explanation":"This is an almost verbatim reproduction of a detailed, appropriation-specific financing clause."},{"child_excerpt":"Such payments shall be made without regard to the provisions of (a) section 3681 of the Revised Statutes (31 U.S.C. 672), (b) section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909, 35 Stat. 1027 (31 U.S.C. 673), and (c) such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.","parent_excerpt":"Such payments shall be made without regard to the provision of (a) section 3681 of the Revised Statutes (31 U.S.C. 672), (b) section 9 of the Act of March 4, 1909, 35 Stat. 1027 (31 U.S.C. 673), and (c) such other laws as the President may hereafter specify.","explanation":"The full three-part statutory-waiver formula is copied essentially word for word, providing strong evidence of direct drafting reuse."}]}
